Save state 2: displays no-Memory-Card dialog (0x80052ffa), waits for confirm via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(2, 0x16), and defaults cancel cursor_item to 1.
Save state 3: displays select-Memory-Card prompt (0x80053530) and calls ovl15_diary_prompt_memcard_port to pick active_port (state 4) or cancel to state 0x16.
Save state 4: polls selected active_port via hm_ovl15_name_entry_input and branches to state 5 (error), 6 (unformatted), 7 (scan slots), or 0x15 (card removed).
Save state 5: displays Memory Card error dialog (0x8005306a) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(5, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.
Save state 6: displays unformatted/check-card message (0x800530c8) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(6, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

Save state 7: scans 3 save slots via ovl15_diary_read_slot_summary and ovl15_diary_check_memcard_space, records slot status codes in g_ovl15_memcard_diary_save_count[0..2], and transitions to state 8. hm_text_draw_box_with_message

Save state 0xb: executes two-step unformatted card prompt (notice via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance, then Yes/No via ovl15_diary_prompt_yes_no), entering state 0xd (format) or 0 (cancel).
Save state 0xd: displays formatting notice (0x8005316c) and calls ovl15_diary_format_memcard(active_port), transitioning to state 0xf (ok), 0x15 (timeout), or 0xe (error).
Save state 0xe: displays format-failed dialog (0x800531b8) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0xe, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.
Save state 0xf: displays creating-file dialog (0x8005346a) and calls ovl15_diary_create_save_file, branching to state 0x13 (ok), 0x11 (full), 0x15 (timeout), or 0x10 (error).
Save state 0x10: displays save-failed dialog (0x80053506) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x10, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.
Save state 0x11: displays insufficient-blocks dialog (0x8005321a) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x11, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.
Save state 0x12: displays corrupt-slot dialog (0x80053294) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x12, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

Save state 0x15: displays Memory Card removed dialog (0x80052f4e) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x15, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

Initializes 3 spectator chicken records at g_ovl19_phase_announce_match_ready_chicken_table[0] from g_ovl19_spectators_crowd_value and sets g_ovl19_spectators_crowd_count by round g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_fighter_spectators_counter.
Rolls CPU chicken opponent affection/strength for round g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_fighter_spectators_counter from g_ovl19_roll_opponent_affection_table (+0xab in round 2).
Renders arena actors and tournament bracket UI, advancing g_ovl19_dispatch_festival_phase_tournament_show_counter to phase 1 on confirm button press (0x60).
Displays round prompt dialogue (4, 0xf/0x10) for round 1/2 and branches g_ovl19_dispatch_festival_phase_tournament_show_counter to phase 3 or 2.
Dispatches bout substate g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_phase_bout_counter in g_ovl19_phase_bout_fn_ptr, steps fighters, and renders actors until substate 7 exits.

Resets bout actors, shows round intro dialogue (g_ovl19_phase_announce_match_calendar_table[round]) for 60 frames, and advances g_ovl19_dispatch_festival_phase_tournament_show_counter to 4. hm_text_set_render_mode, hm_dialogue_set_window_state, evt_res_set_dialog_fade_flag, evt_res_commit_dialog_close

Renders arena and shows pre-fight ready prompt (4, 0x12) for 45 frames before advancing g_ovl19_dispatch_festival_phase_tournament_show_counter to 5. hm_dialogue_set_window_state, evt_res_set_dialog_fade_flag, evt_res_commit_dialog_close

Runs Chicken Sumo ring physics, crow/scare button timing, and ring-out checks ovl19_update_fighters_ai_and_clashes, ovl19_step_all_fighters, ovl19_check_ring_out, ovl19_is_fighter_active_or_dashing, ovl19_render_all_arena_actors, ovl19_set_spectator_state (+5 more)

Renders arena actors, sets tournament victory flag g_ovl19_phase_exit_festival_post_champion_state = 1, and advances g_core_minigame_state.
Resets bout actors, places fighters at ring edges (x=0, z=0xbe/-0xbe, y=-100), sets initial stances, and sets substate 1.
Runs ring entrance dialogue (4, 9), plays cluck SFX 0x3a, sets fighter stances, and transitions g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_phase_bout_counter to 2. hm_dialogue_set_window_state
Plays periodic cluck SFX 0x3a during banter dialogue (4, 10), then triggers crowd/squawk SFX and sets substate 3. hm_dialogue_set_window_state
Runs referee ready prompt (4, 0xb), resets spectators and fighter stances, and advances g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_phase_bout_counter to 4.

Runs active bout dialogue (4, 0xc) with periodic SFX 0x3a until ring-ledge step-off triggers crow SFX and substate 5. hm_text_set_render_mode, hm_audio_play_sfx, hm_dialogue_set_window_state, evt_res_set_dialog_fade_flag, evt_res_commit_dialog_close

Runs ring-out dialogue (4, 0xd), checks ovl19_check_ring_out, resets actors on confirm, and advances substate to 6. ovl19_set_spectator_state, hm_text_set_render_mode, hm_dialogue_set_window_state, evt_res_set_dialog_fade_flag, evt_res_commit_dialog_close
Runs post-bout prompt (4, 0xe) and transitions outer g_ovl19_dispatch_festival_phase_tournament_show_counter to phase 3 (continue) or 2 (end).
Draws tournament bracket winner stamp via ovl19_draw_bracket_winner_stamp and renders all arena actors.

Every g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_cpu_counter_squawk_ai frames rolls CPU squawk/scare trigger (g_ovl19_phase_announce_match_ready_chicken_value_sumo_bout) from range, facing cone, and g_ovl19_fighter_positions_cpu_resolve_counter. ovl19_is_fighter_active_or_dashing, ovl19_set_spectator_state, hm_prng_next

Triggers charge state 4 on spectator crow (g_ovl19_chicken_sumo_fighters_cfg16[0]==2), resolves head-on/back clashes, and rolls idle AI actions. ovl19_get_relative_quadrant, ovl19_is_fighter_active_or_dashing, ovl19_can_fighter_act, ovl19_set_fighter_action, hm_prng_next (+1 more)

Dispatches per-state handlers (3..11) for both fighters at g_ovl19_event_actor_tbl[0] (stride 0x48) and decrements active timers. ovl19_fighter_state_clash_win, ovl19_fighter_state_pushed_back, ovl19_fighter_state_stunned_back, ovl19_fighter_state_tackle_win, ovl19_fighter_state_knocked_back (+1 more)

Turns AI fighter using g_ovl19_fighter_ai_value weights, triggers state 4 squawk when in range/facing, and avoids ring ledges. ovl19_get_relative_quadrant, ovl19_is_step_off_ring_ledge, ovl19_set_fighter_action, hm_prng_next, hm_audio_play_sfx
No-op state handler for Chicken Sumo fighter action state 4 (held squawk/charge stance).
Steps fighter_ptr in recoil state 5 via hm_ovl19_chicken_sumo_update_bout and resets to stance 2 when timer expires.
Steps clash-winner fighter_ptr (state 6) after windup delay g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_fighters_fighter_counter_1 - 0x1e and resets to stance 2 at 0.
Steps pushed-back fighter_ptr (state 7) after delay g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_fighters_fighter_counter_1 - 0x1e and resets to stance 2 at 0.
Steps stunned pushback fighter_ptr (state 8) after delay g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_fighters_fighter_counter_1 - 0x1e and resets to stance 2 at 0.
Steps heavy tackle winner fighter_ptr (state 9) while timer < g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_fighters_fighter_counter_2 - 0x3c and resets to stance 2 at 0.
Steps knocked-back fighter_ptr (state 10), plays impact SFX 0x3c at g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_fighters_fighter_counter_3 - 0x1e, and resets to stance 2 at 0.
Steps falling fighter_ptr (state 0xb) while pos_y < -10 via hm_ovl19_chicken_sumo_update_bout, else sets stance 2.

Advances bracket rounds and updates winning chicken golden-egg status ovl19_fighter_state_pushed_back, ovl19_fighter_state_stunned_back, ovl19_fighter_state_tackle_win, ovl19_fighter_state_knocked_back, ovl19_fighter_state_ringout_fall
Checks if either fighter crossed Y >= -0x5a, sets loser to ring-out state 0xb, and returns 0, 1, or -1.
Compares player vs CPU chicken affection (g_ovl19_fighter_positions_resolve_value vs g_ovl19_fighter_positions_cpu_resolve_counter) with a 91% weighted roll to pick clash winner.
Rolls hm_prng_next(100) against g_ovl19_pick_ai_action_region weight table by affection tier and push flag to return action 0..3.
Checks whether target_ptr lies within distance g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_opponent_counter_1 and front angle cone g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_opponent_counter_front_cone of fighter_ptr.
Calls ovl19_get_relative_quadrant and returns true when the opponent lies in front quadrant 0.
Computes Euclidean XZ distance between two fighter structs (+0x10, +0x14) using PS1 SDK SquareRoot0.
Returns opponent relative direction quadrant (0=front, 1=right, 2=back, 3=left) from fighter_ptr facing. ovl19_is_opponent_directly_ahead
Computes fixed-point XZ bearing angle between two fighter structs (+0x10, +0x14) using PS1 SDK ratan2.
Tests 200 units ahead of fighter_ptr via ovl19_snap_pos_to_arena_floor and returns true if floor Y drops off.
Returns true when fighter_ptr's action_state (+0x02) is 2 (stance) or 3 (advancing). ovl19_update_fighters_ai_and_clashes
Returns true when fighter_ptr's action_timer (+0x06) is <= 0 and action_state (+0x02) is below 4.

Renders both fighter chickens, 3 spectator chickens (g_ovl19_phase_announce_match_ready_chicken_table[0]), and 9 arena props (g_ovl19_render_all_arena_actors_value_1). ovl19_phase_round_prompt, ovl19_phase_run_bout, ovl19_phase_announce_match, ovl19_phase_ready_set, hm_ovl19_chicken_sumo_loop (+3 more)
Selects animation frame/flip for fighter action_state (0..11), submits 3D fighter sprite, and draws clash effect g_ovl19_render_fighter_chicken_actor_arena_value.
Maps spectator state (0..4) to anim ID (0..3), advances animation, and draws 3D sprite via ovl19_draw_actor_3d_sprite.
